description.zh_CN: Horizon：高密度控制台风格的 Komari 主题。集群总览、筛选与排序、节点卡片、流量周期与校准、延迟探针与丢包虚线、历史图表；登录后点首页齿轮进入主题设置。
description.en_US: Horizon: a dense console-style Komari theme — cluster overview, filters & sorting, node cards, traffic cycles & calibration, latency probes with packet-loss lines, history charts. Theme settings: gear button on the homepage when logged in.
